title: Router: let friends reach the Palworld server
description:
Operator decision 2026-10-10: friends outside the house can join the Palworld server on VM 106 (palworld-server, MAC BC:24:11:E8:9F:7A, 192.168.1.106). ADD151 opens udp 8211 from anywhere in its firewall. The rest is the operator's, in the My Spectrum app (Services → Router → Advanced Settings → Port Forwarding & IP Reservations): reserve 192.168.1.106 for that MAC, then Add Port Assignment UDP 8211 → 192.168.1.106:8211. Friends connect to homelab-demo.duckdns.org:8211.

Done when the operator reports both saved, and `grep -A3 'group game' /etc/pve/firewall/cluster.fw` on the host shows the udp 8211 rule with no source restriction.
